hypotheses: try all pairs with nested loops
scan once while storing previously seen values in a hash set

rejected_algorithms.name: brute force nested loops
rejected_algorithms.reason: It is quadratic O(n^2), so it fails the expected linear-time complexity requirement.

invariant: After processing each element, seen contains exactly the values from distinct earlier positions; if the current complement is in seen, a valid pair exists.
edge_cases: single element cannot pair with itself
counterexample_for_wrong_approach: Using the same element twice would incorrectly return true for nums=[5], target=10.
